blocks.text: Since the previous sûrah commemorates the first revelation, this Meccan *sûrah celebrates the glorious night the Quran was revealed, which is* believed to be the night of Ramaḍân 27, 610 C.E. The reason why the *Prophet (* صلى الله عليه وسلم *) was sent with the Quran is spelled out in the next sûrah.*
In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful
The Night the Quran Was Revealed
Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory. [1322]
And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is?
The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.
That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit[1323] descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter.
It is all peace until the break of dawn.
